utilities.remaining: Argument/stdio exhaustion and diagnostic locales remain unqualified. The selected empty-string and double-slash policy and UTF-8 suffix removal now have CSH-080 witnesses.
utilities.required_environment: per-child limits and installed diagnostic locales
utilities.reason: No argv/stdio exhaustion or localized error oracle is supplied.

utilities.remaining: Write/resource errors, alternative double-slash policies and further locale repertoires remain unqualified. Empty/double/redundant slash cases and a UTF-8 path now have CSH-080 witnesses.
utilities.required_environment: per-child resource controls and alternate locale definitions
utilities.reason: The new path cases do not exercise write or allocator failure.

utilities.remaining: Interactive overwrite, traversal cycles and remaining graph combinations, special files beyond FIFOs, cross-filesystem attributes, ACL/privileged ownership preservation, quota/ENOSPC/EIO and interrupted partial copies remain unqualified. Operand/nested-link -H/-L/-P, ordinary owner/mode/timestamps and bounded EFBIG have selected witnesses.
utilities.required_environment: disposable credentials, two private filesystems, ACL/quota/capacity and fault profiles
utilities.reason: Ordinary continuation does not supply privileged ownership, devices or filesystem faults.

utilities.remaining: Additional block/unblock and noerror combinations, short/interrupted device I/O and signal statistics remain unqualified. CSH-080 adds ordinary block/unblock, C-locale case conversion, sync, block+sync, odd swab, seek/truncate/notrunc and skip/count. Darwin stock sync input counts fail; the selected GNU dd is required. EBCDIC/ascii/ibm are XSI-shaded, outside the selected base profile.
utilities.required_environment: scoped short-read/EINTR/EIO controls and active-operation signal delivery
utilities.reason: Regular-file conversions do not exercise interrupted or failing input recovery.

utilities.remaining: Unspecified/default and 512-byte formats, all-filesystem enumeration, quotas, privilege-dependent availability and live capacity boundaries need a disposable filesystem oracle.
utilities.required_environment: private bounded filesystem with independently measured allocation/quota and credentials
utilities.reason: The host volume changes concurrently and must not be filled for an oracle.

utilities.remaining: Recursive allocation totals, hard-link deduplication, -a/-s/-x/-H/-L, unreadable subtrees, shared extents and overflow need independent filesystem-specific accounting.
utilities.required_environment: private filesystem accounting oracle for directories/hard links/shared extents
utilities.reason: st_blocks for one regular file does not establish recursive allocation accounting.

utilities.remaining: Non-empty/magic/encoding classification, -d/-h/-i/-M/-m, magic-file parsing/precedence, symlink errors and locale-dependent descriptions require supplied magic databases and independent samples.
utilities.required_environment: authored magic databases, independent nonempty/encoding samples and locale profiles
utilities.reason: Empty/directory classifications do not qualify magic parsing or precedence.

utilities.remaining: Other expressions/actions, timestamp boundaries, descriptor exhaustion and non-UTF-8 matching remain unqualified. CSH-080 adds exact byte/rounded-block size, numeric permissions, negation/grouping and bounded batched exec.
utilities.required_environment: per-child descriptor limits, deeper trees, timestamps and non-UTF-8 matching oracles
utilities.reason: Bounded expression cases do not establish exhaustion or arbitrary locale matching.

utilities.remaining: Interactive replacement, remaining directory/symlink combinations, cross-device and permission errors, hard-link count limits and filesystem failures remain unqualified. Selected -L/-P precedence, symlink-inode hard links and existing-target preservation have witnesses.
utilities.required_environment: automated prompt fixtures plus disposable cross-device/credential/link-limit profiles
utilities.reason: Hard-link and continuation witnesses do not supply these environments.

utilities.remaining: Long and numeric metadata, timestamps, size/block units, sorting switches, recursive graphs, terminal formatting, locale collation beyond C and I/O exhaustion remain unqualified.
utilities.required_environment: authored metadata/time/block graphs, owned PTYs, non-C collation and I/O limits
utilities.reason: The bounded C ordering switches do not qualify metadata formats or non-C ordering.

utilities.remaining: Further symbolic modes/parents, total path limits, ACL inheritance, access denial and capacity exhaustion remain unqualified. CSH-080 adds final -m versus parent umask, existing mode preservation and continuation after an ENOTDIR prefix.
utilities.required_environment: private ACL/credential and bounded capacity/path-limit profiles
utilities.reason: Parent modes and ENOTDIR continuation are not ACL or access-denial evidence.

utilities.remaining: Additional symbolic/ACL behavior and capacity exhaustion remain unqualified. CSH-080 adds sequential symbolic copy/removal and existing-node error continuation; FIFO transfer remains outside creation.
utilities.required_environment: private ACL/capacity profile and remaining symbolic-mode tables
utilities.reason: Creation witnesses do not establish data transfer, ACLs or exhausted filesystems.

utilities.remaining: Interactive decisions, directory replacement, cross-filesystem copy/remove fallback, metadata/ACL preservation and interrupted or exhausted destination remain unqualified.
utilities.required_environment: private source/destination filesystems, ACL/credential profiles and interruption controls
utilities.reason: Same-filesystem rename/continuation does not exercise copy/remove fallback.

utilities.remaining: Inaccessible prefixes, path total limits and alternate filesystems/repertoires remain unqualified. CSH-080 adds -P and -p/-P order combinations with empty and dash-prefixed components.
utilities.required_environment: controlled inaccessible prefixes and measured alternate filesystem limits
utilities.reason: Portable spelling cases do not establish real path or credential boundaries.

utilities.remaining: pax/cpio formats and extended headers, remaining options/patterns, privileged identities, character-set conversion, multi-volume and recovery remain unqualified. The selected pinned pax repairs ustar mode encoding and final partial writes and requires the complete existing type-graph, truncation, EPIPE, EFBIG and Linux virtual-device ENOSPC assertions. Original Apple/Linux stock-provider failures remain separately retained.
utilities.required_environment: independent pax/cpio/extended-header fixtures, credentials, encoding and multi-volume oracle
utilities.reason: Ustar fixtures and selected repairs do not qualify other formats or recovery.

utilities.remaining: Inaccessible ancestors, deleted directories, total PATH_MAX and allocation/stdio failures remain unqualified by this subset. CSH-080 adds -L/-P last-option precedence with an independently authored logical cwd.
utilities.required_environment: disposable denied/deleted ancestors, path and libc fault controls
utilities.reason: Option precedence does not supply permission or allocation boundaries.

utilities.remaining: Other arbitrary byte/locale combinations, libc-internal allocation failures and true filesystem limits remain unqualified. CSH-080 adds UTF-8 link bytes and test-only provider call-site ENOMEM, distinct from production kernel evidence.
utilities.required_environment: arbitrary byte/repertoire fixtures, real filesystem limits and libc-internal fault controls
utilities.reason: Injected provider call-site ENOMEM does not qualify arbitrary bytes or kernel limits.

utilities.remaining: Permission/namespace races, libc-internal allocation failures, double-leading-slash policy and exact resource boundaries remain unqualified. CSH-080 adds test-only provider call-site ENOMEM including dynamic links and relative/absolute missing-final fallback; it does not inject libc internals.
utilities.required_environment: controlled namespace races/credentials, exact link/path limits and libc-internal faults
utilities.reason: Call-site injection does not qualify libc internal recovery or races.

utilities.remaining: Recursive descriptor/depth exhaustion, disposable mount boundaries, operand continuation, permissions, races and prompt locale/recursive decisions remain unqualified; yes/no controlling-PTY decisions are bounded witnesses.
utilities.required_environment: private mount/depth/credential profiles and automated recursive prompt/race controls
utilities.reason: One-level continuation and yes/no PTY witnesses do not supply mount boundaries.

utilities.remaining: Ancestor permissions, total depth/path boundaries and other filesystem errors remain unqualified. CSH-080 adds symlink rejection and continuation after a nonempty operand.
